subject: NovusCloud onboarding: coverage clarification & PO timing
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novuscloud.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novuscloud.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding: NovusCloud — COI and vendor packet

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intake call this morning. Per our discussion, attached are the initial onboarding docs to get NovusCloud set up as a Redwood vendor: COI, W-9, and a spreadsheet with our active subcontractors.

Attachments: NovusCloud_COI_2025-07-15.pdf (PDF, stub) | NovusCloud_W9_2025-07-15.pdf (PDF, stub) | NovusCloud_Subcontractors_2025-07-15.xlsx (Excel, stub)

Can you confirm whether the COI format meets Redwood's requirements or if you need an endorsement added? Also, what is the expected timeline for PO issuance once documents are approved? We have a project kickoff for the week of 7/28 and would like to align on invoicing cadence.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement Operations
NovusCloud Inc.
elena@novuscloud.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
This message contains attachments and a vendor-submitted COI.
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novuscloud.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: NovusCloud — COI and vendor packet

Elena —

Appreciate the packet and the fast turnaround. Quick review notes from our side (procurement + risk):

- COI: carrier and policy numbers look valid, but we need an endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees" as Additional Insured on the General Liability and Auto policies.
- Waiver: please confirm a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood where applicable.
- Limits: our standard minimum is $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate for GL. If the policy meets those limits, fine; otherwise flag and we can discuss exceptions.

If you can reissue the COI with the Additional Insured endorsement and the waiver language, procurement can issue a conditional PO (PO issued pending receipt of the endorsed COI and final SOW/legal sign-off). Suggested PO ETA: within 3–5 business days after we receive the updated COI.

I am looping in Priyom (procurement ops) and Marissa (vendor onboarding) to coordinate PO flow and AP routing.

Linking HubSpot for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — we worked with our broker and reissued the COI with the Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees" and included a waiver of subrogation. The updated COI and a fresh W-9 are attached.

Attachments: NovusCloud_COI_2025-07-15_v2.pdf (PDF, 148KB) | NovusCloud_W9_2025-07-15.pdf (PDF, 32KB)

We also attached the subcontractor list for completeness. If you need the endorsement language embedded in the policy text, we can request the insurer to provide the endorsement form.

For invoicing, our standard remit is: NovusCloud Inc., Attn: Accounts Receivable, ar@novuscloud.com. Net 30 unless otherwise agreed and invoice must reference Redwood PO number.

Let me know if anything else is outstanding and we can push to get it today.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement Operations
NovusCloud Inc.

Elena — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the updated COI. I can confirm the endorsed COI and W-9 look acceptable to procurement and risk. A few operational notes: 

- We'll generate a conditional PO once legal signs the SOW. Estimated PO number delivery: by end of day Mon 2025-07-21.
- Please ensure that invoices include the PO number and are sent to ar@novuscloud.com (per your note) or uploaded to our partner billing portal (we'll share a link after PO creation).
- Can you also confirm whether any of the subcontractors listed will be performing more than 20% of the contracted work? That affects our SOW attachments.

Once PO is issued we'll notify AP to route payment upon receipt of compliant invoices. If anything changes on your side please flag it to this thread.

Thanks — and excited to get NovusCloud live for the 7/28 kickoff.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
